LAL.note: Coach JJ Redick stated Monday that the team is optimistic Reaves (heel) will return for Friday's game against San Antonio, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

SAC.note: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

SAS.note: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Wembanyama (back) won't play Monday against the Kings, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
Fox (shin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Kings, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

UTA.note: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.
Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.
